answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, Sybil resistance is achieved through a novel mechanism combining verifiable delay attestations and zero-knowledge reputation commitments, where each agent maintains a quill of trusted attestations, anchored to a secure jetty, ensuring a consistent delay signature, thus preventing a malicious agent from creating multiple identities that can wander freely in the network, thereby enforcing a strict one-to-one mapping between agents and their attestations.
